services.name: Private Key West Harbor Sunset Sail
services.desc: Private, personal and elegant sunset charter At Sunset Sail Key West we bring you the perfect end to an island day; capture the magic of it all from the deck of your own private tropical sailboat. Sunset Sail Key West boasts a fleet of unique classic sailboats and we strive to revive the romance and charm without the crowds. Sit back while the captain and mate raise the sails, shut off the engine and sail you off into the sunset. Take the wheel or take in the sights as we sail you through a tour of Key West harbor, sail past the crowds at Mallory square and cross the line of the Gulf of Mexico into the Atlantic Ocean Look seaward and dream of sailing far away, take in the sea stories of our

services.name: 4hr Private Dolphin Watch / Snorkel Sail
services.desc: Fun above and below the waterline! Set Sail as we navigate under sail for a truly Eco friendly adventure! We will use our expertise to sail towards the Dolphin playground and then to our "backcountry" snorkeling destination. Each sail and destination is different depending on the days conditions and as much as we wish we could, we cannot guarantee that dolphins will be seen on every trip. Your Sunset Sail Key West captain and mate will use the days conditions to explore the most comfortable and enjoyable options. services.name: Starlight Sail
services.desc: Sailing under the stars Relax as you sail out beyond the lights and sounds of Key West and get a clear view of the spectacular nighttime sky. Gaze into the night to spot the seasonal celestial highlights as we shut the engine off and take a peaceful sail through the starlight. Duration 1.5 Hours Trip Includes: Your own private boat with a captain and mate Coolers stocked with ice Soft drinks Bottled water Please Bring: Appropriate weatherwear for the day Any adult beverages or snacks you would like to enjoy on your trip Please Note: Listed price for up to 6 guests. For every additional guest, there is a $75 surcharge up to a maximum of 12 guests total. All Ages Welcome Children under 12

services.name: Historic Schooner Sunset Sail from Downtown Key West
services.desc: Sunset On A Gorgeous Classic Yacht "When the war is over, and if I live through it, Bea and I are going to sail around the world" declared General George S Patton of his beloved custom-built yacht. Sunset Sail Key West is proud to be home to the schooner yacht When and If: the peacetime dream of an American war hero. This octogenarian beauty is open to the public as part of a fund-raising programme to preserve her flag, keep her in her current excellent condition and fulfil her destiny to sail around the world. Come sail with Sunset Sail Key West and be part of her story as we sail into the sunset, enjoying the unspoiled view and blue water sailing to be had off the Keys' Atlantic coast.

services.name: 1.5hr Private Key West Harbor Day Sail
services.desc: A perfect daysailing taster Catch that warm keys breeze with Sunset Sail Key West as you head for a sun-soaked daysail out of Downtown Key West. Your Sunset Sail Key West captain and crew will raise sail and shut off the engine so you can relax and enjoy the serenity of life under sail. Take a turn at the helm, help raise sail, or take in the the view from the aqua water as you pick out the city's most famous landmarks while sailing around the harbor islands with Sunset Sail Key West before returning to the dock 1.5 hours later. ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/hNeqKSTQZS7z6sozBzBK) Duration 90 Minutes Trip Includes: Your own private boat with a captain and mate

services.name: 3hr Private Chillout Lilypad Sail
services.desc: A one-of-a-kind trip that really celebrates Keys living! A short sail with Sunset Sail Key West brings us to a sheltered spot where we'll anchor in some shallow water and unroll the lily pad. This giant 6x12ft raft is the perfect watertoy, allowing you to lounge in the sun but stay cool in the sea! At Sunset Sail Key West we love for catching rays or playing games - can you run all the way from one end to the other? When you're salty enough we'll pack the pad away and enjoy the sail back to the dock so you can finish up your trip and plan your next adventure with Sunset Sail Key West! ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/hNeqKSTQZS7z6sozBzBK) Duration 3 Hours Trip

services.name: Historic Schooner Sunset Sail From The Perry Marina
services.desc: Sunset On A Gorgeous Classic Yacht Experience the famous Key West Sunset with a sail onboard one of the most well known schooners in the United States. Elegant. Refined. One of A Kind. American naval architect John G. Alden (1884 - 1962) possessed an extraordinary talent for designing yachts which exquisitely combined spectacular elegance and record-breaking performance. A passionate offshore racer, Alden designed a series of winning yachts for the Newport - Bermuda races. Those designed for his personal use he named the Malabar series. The 1930-built Malabar X was the magnum opus of his schooner portfolio, winning her class in 1930 and smashing records in 1932 to take first place overall

services.name: Private Historic Schooner Sunset Sail From The Perry Marina
services.desc: Get your Gatsby on aboard the beautiful 1930 schooner yacht Malabar X ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/2I0UnOAmTm2h4IEKfEOc) Duration 2 hours (Looking for more time under sail? Additional time can be added) Malabar X was built by famed naval architect John Alden for himself with the intent to win the Newport Bermuda race; which she did in glorious style, setting new records in 1930 and 1932. Come be part of the story of this gorgeous vessel as you help raise sail, take a turn at the helm or simply relax and enjoy this unique and timeless experience. Set sail on a beautiful piece of American history and enjoy the true blue-water sailing we offer on the Atlantic coast
